  455:   // Uses dual mechanism: BroadcastChannel (0ms in modern browsers) + localStorage storage event fallback
  456:   // =========================================================================
  457:   const broadcastRealtimeUpdate = (type: string, data: any) => {
  458:     const payload = { type, data, timestamp: Date.now() };
  459:     try {
  460:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
  461:         const bc = new BroadcastChannel('xn_live_sync_bus');
  462:         bc.postMessage(payload);
  463:         bc.close();
  464:       }
  465:     } catch {}
  466:     try {
  467:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
  468:         localStorage.setItem('xn_realtime_sync_event', JSON.stringify(payload));
  469:       }
  470:     } catch {}
  471:   };
  472: 
  473:   const lastRefreshTimestampRef = useRef<number>(0);
  474: 
  475:   // Safe background data refresh with 60s throttle and equality checking to prevent high egress and disk IO exhaustion
  476:   const refreshAllDataFromDb = async (force = false) => {
  477:     const now = Date.now();
  478:     if (!force && now - lastRefreshTimestampRef.current < 60000) {
  479:       return; // Throttled to prevent disk IO burn
  480:     }
  481:     lastRefreshTimestampRef.current = now;
  482: 
  483:     try {
  484:       const [remoteBookings, remoteNurses, remoteLeads, remoteConsults] = await Promise.all([
  485:         dbFetchBookings(),
  486:         dbFetchNurses(),
  487:         dbFetchLeads(),
  488:         dbFetchConsultations()
  489:       ]);
  490: 
  491:       if (remoteBookings && remoteBookings.length > 0) {
  492:         setBookings((prev) => {
  493:           if (prev.length === remoteBookings.length && JSON.stringify(prev) === JSON.stringify(remoteBookings)) {
  494:             return prev;
  495:           }
  496:           return remoteBookings;
  497:         });
  498:       }
  499:       if (remoteNurses && remoteNurses.length > 0) {
  500:         setNurses((prev) => {
  501:           if (prev.length === remoteNurses.length && JSON.stringify(prev) === JSON.stringify(remoteNurses)) {
  502:             return prev;
  503:           }
  504:           return remoteNurses;
  505:         });
  506:       }
  507:       if (remoteLeads && remoteLeads.length > 0) {
  508:         setLeads((prev) => {
  509:           if (prev.length === remoteLeads.length && JSON.stringify(prev) === JSON.stringify(remoteLeads)) {
  510:             return prev;
  511:           }
  512:           return remoteLeads;
  513:         });
  514:       }
  515:       if (remoteConsults && remoteConsults.length > 0) {
  516:         setConsultations((prev) => {
  517:           if (prev.length === remoteConsults.length && JSON.stringify(prev) === JSON.stringify(remoteConsults)) {
  518:             return prev;
  519:           }
  520:           return remoteConsults;
  521:         });
  522:       }
  523:     } catch (e) {
  524:       console.warn('[Realtime Sync] Background sync warning:', e);
  525:     }
  526:   };
  527: 
  528:   // =========================================================================
  529:   // ZERO-DELAY REALTIME SYNC ENGINE
  530:   // Layer 1: BroadcastChannel (Instant Cross-Tab)
  531:   // Layer 2: localStorage StorageEvent (Instant Cross-Window)
  532:   // Layer 3: Focus & Tab Visibility Change (Instant when user switches tabs)
  533:   // Layer 4: Supabase Realtime WebSocket Subscriptions
  534:   // Layer 5: High-Frequency Background Heartbeat Poller (Every 1.5 seconds)
  535:   // =========================================================================
  536:   useEffect(() => {
  537:     const handleSyncEvent = (type: string, data: any) => {
  538:       if (!type) return;
  539: 
  540:       if (type === 'BOOKING_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  541:         setBookings((prev) => prev.map((b) => (b.id === data.id ? { ...b, ...data } : b)));
  542:       } else if (type === 'BOOKING_CREATE' && data?.id) {
  543:         setBookings((prev) => {
  544:           const exists = prev.some((b) => b.id === data.id);
  545:           return exists ? prev.map((b) => (b.id === data.id ? { ...b, ...data } : b)) : [data, ...prev];
  546:         });
  547:       } else if (type === 'BOOKING_DELETE' && data?.id) {
  548:         setBookings((prev) => prev.filter((b) => b.id !== data.id));
  549:       } else if (type === 'NURSE_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  550:         setNurses((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === data.id ? { ...n, ...data } : n)));
  551:       } else if (type === 'NURSE_CREATE' && data?.id) {
  552:         setNurses((prev) => {
  553:           const exists = prev.some((n) => n.id === data.id);
  554:           return exists ? prev.map((n) => (n.id === data.id ? { ...n, ...data } : n)) : [...prev, data];
  555:         });
  556:       } else if (type === 'NURSE_DELETE' && data?.id) {
  557:         setNurses((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== data.id));
  558:       } else if (type === 'LEAD_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  559:         setLeads((prev) => prev.map((l) => (l.id === data.id ? { ...l, ...data } : l)));
  560:       } else if (type === 'LEAD_CREATE' && data?.id) {
  561:         setLeads((prev) => {
  562:           const exists = prev.some((l) => l.id === data.id);
  563:           return exists ? prev.map((l) => (l.id === data.id ? { ...l, ...data } : l)) : [data, ...prev];
  564:         });
  565:       } else if (type === 'LEAD_DELETE' && data?.id) {
  566:         setLeads((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.id !== data.id));
  567:       } else if (type === 'CONSULTATION_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  568:         setConsultations((prev) => prev.map((c) => (c.id === data.id ? { ...c, ...data } : c)));
  569:       } else if (type === 'CONSULTATION_CREATE' && data?.id) {
  570:         setConsultations((prev) => {
  571:           const exists = prev.some((c) => c.id === data.id);
  572:           return exists ? prev.map((c) => (c.id === data.id ? { ...c, ...data } : c)) : [data, ...prev];
  573:         });
  574:       } else if (type === 'CONSULTATION_DELETE' && data?.id) {
  575:         setConsultations((prev) => prev.filter((c) => c.id !== data.id));
  576:       } else if (type === 'SERVICE_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  577:         setServices((prev) => prev.map((s) => (s.id === data.id ? { ...s, ...data } : s)));
  578:       } else if (type === 'SERVICE_CREATE' && data?.id) {
  579:         setServices((prev) => {
  580:           const exists = prev.some((s) => s.id === data.id);
  581:           return exists ? prev.map((s) => (s.id === data.id ? { ...s, ...data } : s)) : [...prev, data];
  582:         });
  583:       } else if (type === 'SERVICE_DELETE' && data?.id) {

  585:       } else if (type === 'COUPON_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  586:         setCoupons((prev) => prev.map((c) => (c.id === data.id ? { ...c, ...data } : c)));
  587:       } else if (type === 'COUPON_CREATE' && (data?.id || data?.code)) {
  588:         setCoupons((prev) => {
  589:           const exists = prev.some((c) => c.id === data.id || c.code === data.code);
  590:           return exists ? prev.map((c) => (c.id === data.id || c.code === data.code ? { ...c, ...data } : c)) : [data, ...prev];
  591:         });
  592:       } else if (type === 'COUPON_DELETE' && data?.id) {
  593:         setCoupons((prev) => prev.filter((c) => c.id !== data.id));
  594:       } else if (type === 'APP_USER_UPDATE' && data?.id) {
  595:         setAppUsers((prev) => prev.map((u) => (u.id === data.id ? { ...u, ...data } : u)));
  596:       } else if (type === 'APP_USER_CREATE' && data?.id) {
  597:         setAppUsers((prev) => {
  598:           const exists = prev.some((u) => u.id === data.id);
  599:           return exists ? prev.map((u) => (u.id === data.id ? { ...u, ...data } : u)) : [...prev, data];
  600:         });
  601:       } else if (type === 'APP_USER_DELETE' && data?.id) {
  602:         setAppUsers((prev) => prev.filter((u) => u.id !== data.id));
  603:       } else if (type === 'RESYNC_ALL') {
  604:         refreshAllDataFromDb(true);
  605:       }
  606:     };
  607: 
  608:     // 1. Cross-Tab Broadcast Channel
  609:     let bc: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
  610:     try {
  611:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
  612:         bc = new BroadcastChannel('xn_live_sync_bus');
  613:         bc.onmessage = (event) => {
  614:           const { type, data } = event.data || {};
  615:           handleSyncEvent(type, data);
  616:         };
  617:       }
  618:     } catch {}
  619: 
  620:     // 2. Storage event listener (fires across all tabs/windows in the browser)
  621:     const handleStorageEvent = (e: StorageEvent) => {
  622:       if (e.key === 'xn_realtime_sync_event' && e.newValue) {
  623:         try {
  624:           const { type, data } = JSON.parse(e.newValue);
  625:           handleSyncEvent(type, data);
  626:         } catch {}
  627:       }
  628:     };
  629:     window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageEvent);
  630: 
  631:     // 3. Tab Focus & Visibility Resync (instantly sync when switching between tabs without reload)
  632:     const handleFocusOrVisibility = () => {
  633:       if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
  634:         refreshAllDataFromDb();
  635:       }
  636:     };
  637:     window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocusOrVisibility);

  828:     // 5. Gentle Heartbeat Poller: Reduced from 1.5s to 5 minutes to eliminate disk IO budget depletion and excess egress.
  829:     // Live updates are already pushed instantaneously via Supabase WebSockets (above) and BroadcastChannel cross-tab.
  830:     const heartbeatTimer = setInterval(() => {
  831:       if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
  832:         refreshAllDataFromDb(false);
  833:       }
  834:     }, 300000);
  835:

  838:       clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);

  840:       window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocusOrVisibility);
  841:       document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleFocusOrVisibility);
  842:       if (bc) bc.close();
  843:     };

  846:   // Handler: When user books a service from public site
  847:   const handleBookingCreated = (newBooking: Booking) => {
  848:     // If booked via direct nurse referral link, auto-lock to referring nurse (Rule 1)
  849:     // Otherwise, mark as Pending so Admin can review and dispatch to nurse
  850:     const isDirectNurseReferral = !!newBooking.referringNurseId;
  851:     let assignedNurseId: string | undefined = undefined;
  852:     let assignedNurseName: string | undefined = undefined;
  853: 
  854:     if (isDirectNurseReferral) {
  855:       const referringNurse = nurses.find((n) => n.id === newBooking.referringNurseId);
  856:       if (referringNurse) {
  857:         assignedNurseId = referringNurse.id;
  858:         assignedNurseName = `${referringNurse.name} (Direct Referral - Rule 1)`;
  859:       }
  860:     }
  861: 
  862:     const finalizedBooking: Booking = {
  863:       ...newBooking,
  864:       status: isDirectNurseReferral ? 'Assigned' : 'Pending',
  865:       assignedNurseId,
  866:       assignedNurseName
  867:     };
  868: 
  869:     setBookings((prev) => [finalizedBooking, ...prev]);
  870:     broadcastRealtimeUpdate('BOOKING_CREATE', finalizedBooking);
  871:     dbSaveBooking(finalizedBooking);
  872:   };
  873: 
  874:   // Handler: Nurse submits a lead (Direct to Admin - NOT auto-assigned to any nurse)
  875:   const handleAddNewLead = (newLead: NurseLead) => {
  876:     // Lead enters "Pending Approval" state directly for Admin review; NOT assigned to any nurse
  877:     const isColleagueReferral = Boolean(newLead.referredNurseName || newLead.id.startsWith('REF-NUR'));
  878:     const pendingLead: NurseLead = {
  879:       ...newLead,
  880:       assignedNurseId: undefined, // Explicitly not assigned to any nurse; Admin will decide
  881:       status: 'Pending Approval',
  882:       pointsAwarded: isColleagueReferral ? 50 : 0,
  883:       referralCommissionRupees: isColleagueReferral ? 500 : 0
  884:     };
  885: 
  886:     setLeads((prev) => [pendingLead, ...prev]);
  887:     broadcastRealtimeUpdate('LEAD_CREATE', pendingLead);
  888:     dbSaveLead(pendingLead);
  889: 
  890:     // Increment nurse's total submitted leads / referrals counter
  891:     const referringNurse = nurses.find((n) => n.id === newLead.nurseId);
  892:     if (referringNurse) {
  893:       const updatedReferringNurse: NurseProfile = {
  894:         ...referringNurse,
  895:         totalLeads: referringNurse.totalLeads + 1,
  896:         totalReferrals: isColleagueReferral ? (referringNurse.totalReferrals || 0) + 1 : referringNurse.totalReferrals,
  897:         earningsPending: isColleagueReferral ? (referringNurse.earningsPending || 0) + 500 : referringNurse.earningsPending
  898:       };
  899:       setNurses((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === updatedReferringNurse.id ? updatedReferringNurse : n)));
  900:       broadcastRealtimeUpdate('NURSE_UPDATE', updatedReferringNurse);
  901:       dbUpdateNurse(updatedReferringNurse);
  902:     }
  903:   };
  904: 
  905:   // Handler: Admin Approves Lead & decides Points and Referral Earnings
  906:   const handleAdminApproveLead = async (
  907:     leadId: string,
  908:     pointsAwarded: number,
  909:     referralRupees: number,
  910:     adminNotes?: string
  911:   ) => {
  912:     const lead = leads.find((l) => l.id === leadId);
  913:     if (!lead) return;
  914: 
  915:     const approvedLead: NurseLead = {
  916:       ...lead,
  917:       status: 'Approved',
  918:       pointsAwarded,
  919:       referralCommissionRupees: referralRupees,
  920:       approvedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  921:       approvedBy: 'Admin',
  922:       adminNotes
  923:     };
  924: 
  925:     setLeads((prev) => prev.map((l) => (l.id === leadId ? approvedLead : l)));
  926:     broadcastRealtimeUpdate('LEAD_UPDATE', approvedLead);
  927:     await dbUpdateLeadById(leadId, approvedLead);
  928: 
  929:     // Credit Referring Nurse with Admin-decided points & referral earnings
  930:     const referringNurse = nurses.find((n) => n.id === lead.nurseId);
  931:     if (referringNurse) {
  932:       const updatedNurse: NurseProfile = {
  933:         ...referringNurse,
  934:         pointsEarned: (referringNurse.pointsEarned || 0) + pointsAwarded,
  935:         referralEarningsRupees: (referringNurse.referralEarningsRupees || 0) + referralRupees,
  936:         convertedLeads: (referringNurse.convertedLeads || 0) + 1,
  937:         totalReferrals: (referringNurse.totalReferrals || 0) + 1
  938:       };
  939:       setNurses((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === updatedNurse.id ? updatedNurse : n)));
  940:       broadcastRealtimeUpdate('NURSE_UPDATE', updatedNurse);
  941:       await dbUpdateNurse(updatedNurse);
  942:     }
  943: 
  944:     // Update matching booking's referral bonus record
  945:     setBookings((prev) =>
  946:       prev.map((b) => {
  947:         if (b.patientPhone === lead.patientPhone || (b.referringNurseId === lead.nurseId && b.patientName === lead.patientName)) {
  948:           const updatedB = {
  949:             ...b,
  950:             referralBonusRupees: referralRupees,
  951:             notes: `${b.notes || ''} [Admin Approved: +${pointsAwarded} pts, ₹${referralRupees} referral earning credited]`.trim()
  952:           };
  953:           broadcastRealtimeUpdate('BOOKING_UPDATE', updatedB);
  954:           return updatedB;
  955:         }
  956:         return b;
  957:       })
  958:     );
  959:   };
  960: 
  961:   // Handler: Admin Rejects Lead
  962:   const handleAdminRejectLead = async (leadId: string, adminNotes?: string) => {
  963:     const lead = leads.find((l) => l.id === leadId);
  964:     if (!lead) return;
  965: 
  966:     const rejectedLead: NurseLead = {
  967:       ...lead,
  968:       status: 'Rejected',
  969:       pointsAwarded: 0,
  970:       referralCommissionRupees: 0,
  971:       approvedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  972:       approvedBy: 'Admin',
  973:       rejectedBy: 'Admin',
  974:       rejectionReason: adminNotes || 'Rejected by Admin review',
  975:       adminNotes: adminNotes || 'Rejected by Admin review'
  976:     };
  977: 
  978:     setLeads((prev) => prev.map((l) => (l.id === leadId ? rejectedLead : l)));
  979:     broadcastRealtimeUpdate('LEAD_UPDATE', rejectedLead);
  980:     await dbUpdateLeadById(leadId, rejectedLead);
  981:   };
  982: 
  983:   // Handler: Reassign / Transfer Booking between Nurses
  984:   const handleReassignBooking = (bookingId: string, targetNurseId: string) => {
  985:     const targetNurse = nurses.find((n) => n.id === targetNurseId);
  986:     if (!targetNurse) return;
  987: 
  988:     setBookings((prev) =>
  989:       prev.map((b) => {
  990:         if (b.id === bookingId) {
  991:           const updated: Booking = {
  992:             ...b,
  993:             assignedNurseId: targetNurse.id,
  994:             assignedNurseName: `${targetNurse.name} (${targetNurse.serviceArea})`,
  995:             notes: (b.notes ? b.notes + ' • ' : '') + `Transferred to ${targetNurse.name} (${targetNurse.serviceArea})`
  996:           };
  997:           broadcastRealtimeUpdate('BOOKING_UPDATE', updated);
  998:           dbSaveBooking(updated);
  999:           return updated;
 1000:         }
 1001:         return b;
 1002:       })
 1003:     );
 1004:   };

 1009:     broadcastRealtimeUpdate('NURSE_UPDATE', updated);
 1010:     dbUpdateNurse(updated);
 1011:   };

 1013:   // Handler: Admin assigns or reassigns order
 1014:   const handleAdminAssignOrder = (bookingId: string, nurseId: string, ruleExplanation: string) => {
 1015:     const nurseObj = nurses.find((n) => n.id === nurseId);
 1016:     setBookings((prev) =>
 1017:       prev.map((b) => {
 1018:         if (b.id === bookingId) {
 1019:           const wasRejected = b.status === 'Rejected' || b.nurseAcceptanceStatus === 'Rejected';
 1020:           const auditMsg = wasRejected 
 1021:             ? `Referred & reassigned to Nurse ${nurseObj?.name || nurseId} by Admin (${ruleExplanation})`
 1022:             : undefined;
 1023:           const updatedNotes = auditMsg ? (b.notes ? `${b.notes} • ${auditMsg}` : auditMsg) : b.notes;
 1024: 
 1025:           const updated: Booking = {
 1026:             ...b,
 1027:             status: 'Assigned',
 1028:             nurseAcceptanceStatus: 'Pending',
 1029:             assignedNurseId: nurseId,
 1030:             assignedNurseName: `${nurseObj?.name || 'Nurse'} (${ruleExplanation})`,
 1031:             rejectedBy: undefined,
 1032:             rejectionReason: undefined,
 1033:             rejectedNurseId: undefined,
 1034:             rejectedNurseName: undefined,
 1035:             rejectedAt: undefined,
 1036:             notes: updatedNotes
 1037:           };
 1038:           broadcastRealtimeUpdate('BOOKING_UPDATE', updated);
 1039:           dbSaveBooking(updated);
 1040:           return updated;
 1041:         }
 1042:         return b;
 1043:       })
 1044:     );
 1045:   };
 1046: 
 1047:   // Handler: Admin Auto-Routes all pending via Rule 2
 1048:   const handleAutoRouteAll = () => {
 1049:     setBookings((prev) => {
 1050:       const updatedList = prev.map((b) => {
 1051:         if (b.status === 'Pending') {
 1052:           const areaNurse = nurses.find((n) => n.serviceArea === b.area && n.certificateVerified) || nurses.find((n) => n.certificateVerified);
 1053:           if (!areaNurse) {
 1054:             return b; // Do not assign if no verified nurse is available
 1055:           }
 1056:           const updated: Booking = {
 1057:             ...b,
 1058:             status: 'Assigned',
 1059:             assignedNurseId: areaNurse.id,
 1060:             assignedNurseName: `${areaNurse.name} (Auto Area Match - Rule 2)`
 1061:           };
 1062:           broadcastRealtimeUpdate('BOOKING_UPDATE', updated);
 1063:           dbSaveBooking(updated);
 1064:           return updated;
 1065:         }
 1066:         return b;
 1067:       });
 1068:       broadcastRealtimeUpdate('RESYNC_ALL', {});
 1069:       return updatedList;
 1070:     });

 1073:   // Handler: Doctor issues prescription — persist to Supabase & Cloudflare R2
 1074:   const handleDoctorIssueRx = async (consultId: string, rxText: string, recommendedService: ServiceId) => {
 1075:     const targetConsult = consultations.find((c) => c.id === consultId);
 1076:     const patName = targetConsult?.patientName || 'Patient';
 1077:     const rxFileName = `Doctor_Rx_${consultId}_${patName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}.pdf`;
 1078: 
 1079:     // 1. Update React state for consultations
 1080:     const updatedConsultationRecord = {
 1081:       id: consultId,
 1082:       status: 'Prescription Issued' as const,
 1083:       prescriptionIssued: true,
 1084:       prescriptionText: rxText,
 1085:       recommendedService
 1086:     };
 1087:     setConsultations((prev) =>
 1088:       prev.map((c) => {
 1089:         if (c.id === consultId) {
 1090:           return {
 1091:             ...c,
 1092:             ...updatedConsultationRecord
 1093:           };
 1094:         }
 1095:         return c;
 1096:       })
 1097:     );
 1098:     broadcastRealtimeUpdate('CONSULTATION_UPDATE', updatedConsultationRecord);
 1099: 
 1100:     // 2. Persist to Supabase DB consultations table
 1101:     try {
 1102:       await dbUpdateConsultationById(consultId, {
 1103:         status: 'Prescription Issued',
 1104:         prescriptionIssued: true,
 1105:         prescriptionText: rxText,
 1106:         recommendedService
 1107:       });
 1108:       console.log(`[Supabase] Consultation ${consultId} prescription saved.`);
 1109:     } catch (err) {
 1110:       console.error('[Supabase] Failed to update consult prescription:', err);
 1111:     }
 1112: 
 1113:     // 3. Register prescription in Cloudflare R2 storage under prescriptions category for instant in-app viewing
 1114:     try {
 1115:       await uploadToCloudflareStorage({
 1116:         fileName: rxFileName,
 1117:         category: 'prescriptions',
 1118:         contentType: 'application/pdf',
 1119:         sizeBytes: 128400,
 1120:         metadata: {
 1121:           consultationId: consultId,
 1122:           patientName: patName,
 1123:           patientPhone: targetConsult?.patientPhone,
 1124:           recommendedService,
 1125:           prescriptionText: rxText,
 1126:           doctorName: 'Dr. Vikramaditya, MD (Internal Medicine)',
 1127:           issuedAt: new Date().toISOString()
 1128:         }
 1129:       });
 1130:       console.log(`[Cloudflare R2] Prescription record created for ${patName}.`);
 1131:     } catch (err) {
 1132:       console.warn('[Cloudflare R2] Rx record error:', err);
 1133:     }
 1134: 
 1135:     // 4. Synchronize or create patient booking so Admin and Nurse dashboards immediately receive the authorized visit
 1136:     const matchedService = services.find((s) => s.id === recommendedService);
 1137:     const serviceTitle = matchedService?.title || 'Saline Infusion Therapy';
 1138:     const fee = matchedService?.priceNumber || 629;
 1139: 
 1140:     let hasMatchedBooking = false;
 1141:     setBookings((prev) =>
 1142:       prev.map((b) => {
 1143:         const phoneMatch = targetConsult?.patientPhone && b.patientPhone.replace(/\D/g, '').endsWith(targetConsult.patientPhone.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10));
 1144:         const nameMatch = b.patientName.toLowerCase().trim() === patName.toLowerCase().trim();
 1145:         if (phoneMatch || nameMatch) {
 1146:           hasMatchedBooking = true;
 1147:           const updated: Booking = {
 1148:             ...b,
 1149:             hasPrescription: true,
 1150:             prescriptionIssued: true,
 1151:             prescriptionFileName: rxFileName,
 1152:             serviceId: recommendedService,
 1153:             serviceTitle,
 1154:             notes: `${b.notes ? b.notes + ' • ' : ''}Authorized by Dr. Vikramaditya, MD: "${rxText.slice(0, 70)}..."`
 1155:           };
 1156:           broadcastRealtimeUpdate('BOOKING_UPDATE', updated);
 1157:           dbSaveBooking(updated);
 1158:           return updated;
 1159:         }
 1160:         return b;
 1161:       })
 1162:     );
 1163: 
 1164:     if (!hasMatchedBooking && targetConsult) {
 1165:       const newBooking: Booking = {
 1166:         id: `BK-DOC-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
 1167:         serviceId: recommendedService,
 1168:         serviceTitle,
 1169:         patientName: patName,
 1170:         patientPhone: targetConsult.patientPhone,
 1171:         patientAge: targetConsult.patientAge,
 1172:         patientGender: 'Female',
 1173:         area: targetConsult.area,
 1174:         fullAddress: `${targetConsult.area}, Hyderabad (Doctor Tele-Consult Order)`,
 1175:         preferredDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
 1176:         preferredTime: 'Immediate (Doctor Prescribed)',
 1177:         bookingType: 'Instant',
 1178:         status: 'Pending',
 1179:         hasPrescription: true,
 1180:         prescriptionFileName: rxFileName,
 1181:         estimatedFee: fee,
 1182:         finalFee: fee,
 1183:         createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 1184:         notes: `Doctor Authorized Rx: "${rxText.slice(0, 80)}"`
 1185:       };
 1186:       await handleCreateBooking(newBooking);
 1187:     }
 1188:   };

 1447:             onUpdateAppUser={handleUpdateAppUser}
 1448:             onDeleteAppUser={handleDeleteAppUser}
 1449:           />
 1450:         )}
 1451:

 1468:         )}

 1482:               if (remoteLeads) setLeads(remoteLeads);
 1483:             }}
 1484:           />
 1485:         )}
 1486:

 1488:         {!isKnownRoute && (
 1489:           <NotFoundPage

 1492:           />

  418:     e.preventDefault();
  419:     if (!couponForm.code.trim()) {
  420:       setCouponFormError('Coupon code is required.');
  421:       return;
  422:     }
  423:     if (couponForm.discountValue <= 0) {

  436:       const payload = {

  438:         discountType: couponForm.discountType,
  439:         discountValue: Number(couponForm.discountValue),
  440:         maxDiscount: couponForm.maxDiscount ? Number(couponForm.maxDiscount) : undefined,

  454:         if (onCreateCoupon) {
  455:           await onCreateCoupon(payload);
  456:         }
  457:         setCouponFeedback(`Coupon "${payload.code}" created and live in Supabase!`);
  458:       }

  460:       setIsCouponModalOpen(false);

  465:       setIsSubmittingCoupon(false);
  466:     }

  238:           console.error('Error reverse geocoding:', err);
  239:           setLocationSuccessMsg('✓ Location pinned. Please confirm door/flat number.');
  240:         } finally {
  241:           setIsDetectingLocation(false);
  242:         }
  243:       },
  244:       (err) => {
  245:         setIsDetectingLocation(false);
  246:         setErrors((prev) => ({
  247:           ...prev,
  248:           address: 'Could not access location. Please type your address manually below.'
  249:         }));
  250:       },
  251:       { timeout: 10000, enableHighAccuracy: true }
  252:     );

  255:   const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  256:     if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
  257:       const file = e.target.files[0];
  258: 
  259:       // File validation: PDF or Images, max 15MB
  260:       const allowedTypes = ['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpg'];
  261:       if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type) && !file.name.match(/\.(pdf|jpe?g|png|webp)$/i)) {
  262:         setErrors((prev) => ({
  263:           ...prev,
  264:           prescription: 'Invalid format. Please upload a PDF or Image (JPG, PNG, WEBP).'
  265:         }));
  266:         return;
  267:       }
  268: 
  269:       if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
  270:         setErrors((prev) => ({
  271:           ...prev,
  272:           prescription: 'File size exceeds limit. Maximum allowed size is 15 MB.'
  273:         }));
  274:         return;
  275:       }
  276: 
  277:       setPrescriptionFile(file);
  278:       setPrescriptionFileName(file.name);
  279:       setHasPrescription(true);
  280:       setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, prescription: '' }));
  281:       setIsUploadingToR2(true);
  282:       setR2UploadSuccess(false);
  283: 
  284:       // Instant local preview
  285:       if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
  286:         const reader = new FileReader();
  287:         reader.onload = () => {
  288:           setPrescriptionPreviewData(reader.result as string);
  289:         };
  290:         reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  291:       } else {
  292:         setPrescriptionPreviewData('');
  293:       }
  294: 
  295:       try {
  296:         // Upload immediately to Cloudflare R2 Bucket
  297:         const r2Obj = await uploadPrescriptionToCloudflareBucket({
  298:           file,
  299:           patientName: patientName.trim() || 'Prescription Patient',
  300:           patientPhone: patientPhone.trim() || '',
  301:           serviceTitle: currentService.title
  302:         });
  303: 
  304:         setPrescriptionUrl(r2Obj.publicUrl);
  305:         setPrescriptionFileName(r2Obj.fileName);
  306:         setR2UploadSuccess(true);
  307:       } catch (uploadErr) {
  308:         console.error('Cloudflare R2 Bucket upload error:', uploadErr);
  309:         setErrors((prev) => ({
  310:           ...prev,
  311:           prescription: 'Cloudflare upload warning: File queued for retry.'
  312:         }));
  313:       } finally {
  314:         setIsUploadingToR2(false);
  315:       }
  316:     }
  317:   };
  318: 
  319:   const handleRemovePrescription = () => {
  320:     setPrescriptionFile(null);
  321:     setPrescriptionFileName('');
  322:     setPrescriptionUrl('');
  323:     setPrescriptionPreviewData('');
  324:     setR2UploadSuccess(false);
  325:   };

### FILE 17/41: src/components/LocationPickerMap.tsx
### TOTAL LINES: 304
################################################################################

    1: import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
    2: import L from 'leaflet';
    3: import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
    4: import { HyderabadArea } from '../types';
    5: import { MapPin, Navigation, Compass, CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
    6: 
    7: interface LocationPickerMapProps {
    8:   selectedArea: HyderabadArea;
    9:   onAreaChange: (area: HyderabadArea) => void;
   10:   onLocationSelect?: (lat: number, lng: number, addressSuggestion?: string) => void;
   11: }
   12: 
   13: // Coordinates for Hyderabad core healthcare hubs
   14: const HYDERABAD_COORDINATES: Record<HyderabadArea, [number, number]> = {
   15:   'Gachibowli': [17.4401, 78.3489],
   16:   'Madhapur': [17.4483, 78.3915],
   17:   'Banjara Hills': [17.4156, 78.4350],
   18:   'Jubilee Hills': [17.4319, 78.4073],
   19:   'Hitec City': [17.4435, 78.3772],
   20:   'Kondapur': [17.4699, 78.3578],
   21:   'Kukatpally': [17.4938, 78.3999],
   22:   'Secunderabad': [17.4399, 78.4983],
   23:   'LB Nagar': [17.3457, 78.5522],
   24:   'Dilsukhnagar': [17.3688, 78.5247]
   25: };
   26: 
   27: export const LocationPickerMap: React.FC<LocationPickerMapProps> = ({
   28:   selectedArea,
   29:   onAreaChange,
   30:   onLocationSelect
   31: }) => {
   32:   const mapContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
   33:   const mapInstanceRef = useRef<L.Map | null>(null);
   34:   const markerRef = useRef<L.Marker | null>(null);
   35:   const circleRef = useRef<L.Circle | null>(null);
   36: 
   37:   const [coords, setCoords] = useState<[number, number]>(HYDERABAD_COORDINATES[selectedArea] || [17.4483, 78.3915]);
   38:   const [isLocating, setIsLocating] = useState(false);
   39:   const [locationStatus, setLocationStatus] = useState<string>('Pin your exact home/doorstep location');
   40: 
   41:   // Find nearest defined Hyderabad area to coordinates
   42:   const getNearestArea = (lat: number, lng: number): HyderabadArea => {
   43:     let nearest: HyderabadArea = selectedArea;
   44:     let minDistance = Infinity;
   45: 
   46:     Object.entries(HYDERABAD_COORDINATES).forEach(([area, [aLat, aLng]]) => {
   47:       const d = Math.hypot(lat - aLat, lng - aLng);
   48:       if (d < minDistance) {
   49:         minDistance = d;
   50:         nearest = area as HyderabadArea;
   51:       }
   52:     });
   53: 
   54:     return nearest;
   55:   };
   56: 
   57:   // Custom Medical Pin SVG Icon
   58:   const createMedicalPinIcon = () => {
   59:     return L.divIcon({
   60:       className: 'custom-medical-pin',
   61:       html: `
   62:         <div style="position: relative; width: 42px; height: 42px; transform: translate(-50%, -100%);">
   63:           <div style="
   64:             position: absolute;
   65:             bottom: -6px;
   66:             left: 50%;
   67:             transform: translateX(-50%);
   68:             width: 14px;
   69:             height: 6px;
   70:             background: rgba(15, 39, 68, 0.35);
   71:             border-radius: 50%;
   72:             filter: blur(1.5px);
   73:           "></div>
   74:           <div style="
   75:             width: 38px;
   76:             height: 38px;
   77:             background: #E63946;
   78:             border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0;
   79:             transform: rotate(-45deg);
   80:             display: flex;
   81:             align-items: center;
   82:             justify-content: center;
   83:             box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.45);
   84:             border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
   85:           ">
   86:             <div style="
   87:               transform: rotate(45deg);
   88:               color: white;
   89:               font-weight: 900;
   90:               font-size: 16px;
   91:               line-height: 1;
   92:             ">+</div>
   93:           </div>
   94:         </div>
   95:       `,
   96:       iconSize: [42, 42],
   97:       iconAnchor: [21, 42]
   98:     });
   99:   };
  100: 
  101:   // Initialize Map
  102:   useEffect(() => {
  103:     if (!mapContainerRef.current) return;
  104: 
  105:     if (!mapInstanceRef.current) {
  106:       const initialPos = HYDERABAD_COORDINATES[selectedArea] || [17.4483, 78.3915];
  107: 
  108:       const map = L.map(mapContainerRef.current, {
  109:         center: initialPos,
  110:         zoom: 14,
  111:         scrollWheelZoom: false, // Prevents interfering with modal scrolling
  112:         zoomControl: true
  113:       });
  114: 
  115:       // Direct OpenStreetMap standard tiles (100% free, no API key watermark)
  116:       const osmLayer = L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
  117:         attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors',
  118:         maxZoom: 19
  119:       });
  120:       osmLayer.addTo(map);
  121: 
  122:       // Dispatch coverage circle (1.5km radius from pin)
  123:       const circle = L.circle(initialPos, {
  124:         color: '#E63946',
  125:         fillColor: '#E63946',
  126:         fillOpacity: 0.1,
  127:         weight: 1.5,
  128:         dashArray: '4, 4',
  129:         radius: 1200
  130:       }).addTo(map);
  131:       circleRef.current = circle;
  132: 
  133:       // Draggable Marker
  134:       const marker = L.marker(initialPos, {
  135:         draggable: true,
  136:         icon: createMedicalPinIcon()
  137:       }).addTo(map);
  138: 
  139:       marker.on('dragend', () => {
  140:         const pos = marker.getLatLng();
  141:         setCoords([pos.lat, pos.lng]);
  142:         circle.setLatLng(pos);
  143:         const nearest = getNearestArea(pos.lat, pos.lng);
  144:         onAreaChange(nearest);
  145:         setLocationStatus(`Pinned near ${nearest} (${pos.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${pos.lng.toFixed(4)})`);
  146:         if (onLocationSelect) {
  147:           onLocationSelect(pos.lat, pos.lng, `${nearest}, Hyderabad`);
  148:         }

  150: 
  151:       map.on('click', (e: L.LeafletMouseEvent) => {
  152:         const { lat, lng } = e.latlng;
  153:         marker.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
  154:         circle.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
  155:         setCoords([lat, lng]);
  156:         const nearest = getNearestArea(lat, lng);
  157:         onAreaChange(nearest);
  158:         setLocationStatus(`Pinned near ${nearest} (${lat.toFixed(4)}, ${lng.toFixed(4)})`);
  159:         if (onLocationSelect) {

  161:         }
  162:       });

  164:       mapInstanceRef.current = map;
  165:       markerRef.current = marker;
  166:

  169:       setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize(), 450);
  170:     }
  171:

  174:         mapInstanceRef.current.remove();

  176:       }

  179: 
  180:   // Update map when selectedArea changes from parent dropdown/pills
  181:   useEffect(() => {

  183:     if (targetCoords && mapInstanceRef.current && markerRef.current && circleRef.current) {
  184:       mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo(targetCoords, 14, { duration: 1.2 });

  189:     }
  190:   }, [selectedArea]);
  191: 
  192:   // Use HTML5 Geolocation API
  193:   const handleLocateMe = () => {
  194:     if (!navigator.geolocation) {
  195:       alert('Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
  196:       return;
  197:     }
  198: 
  199:     setIsLocating(true);
  200:     setLocationStatus('Locating your GPS coordinates in Hyderabad...');
  201:

  203:       (pos) => {
  204:         const { latitude, longitude } = pos.coords;
  205:         setIsLocating(false);
  206: 
  207:         // Center on user position
  208:         if (mapInstanceRef.current && markerRef.current && circleRef.current) {
  209:           mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo([latitude, longitude], 16, { duration: 1.5 });
  210:           markerRef.current.setLatLng([latitude, longitude]);
  211:           circleRef.current.setLatLng([latitude, longitude]);

  213:

  215:           onAreaChange(nearest);
  216:           setLocationStatus(`📍 GPS Locked: Near ${nearest}`);

  221:       },

  225:         setLocationStatus('Could not detect GPS. Please tap your area on the map.');

   54: // Helper to convert base64 data URLs to safe Blob URLs that modern browsers won't block
   55: export function getSafeBlobUrl(dataUrl: string): string {
   56:   try {
   57:     if (!dataUrl || !dataUrl.startsWith('data:')) return dataUrl;
   58:     const parts = dataUrl.split(';base64,');
   59:     if (parts.length < 2) return dataUrl;
   60:     const contentType = parts[0].split(':')[1] || 'image/png';
   61:     const raw = window.atob(parts[1]);
   62:     const rawLength = raw.length;
   63:     const uInt8Array = new Uint8Array(rawLength);
   64:     for (let i = 0; i < rawLength; ++i) {
   65:       uInt8Array[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
   66:     }
   67:     const blob = new Blob([uInt8Array], { type: contentType });
   68:     return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   69:   } catch (e) {
   70:     return dataUrl;
   71:   }
   72: }

### FILE 29/41: src/hooks/useBodyScrollLock.ts
### TOTAL LINES: 18
################################################################################

    1: ﻿import { useEffect } from 'react';
    2: import { lockBodyScroll, unlockBodyScroll } from '../lib/scrollLock';
    3: 
    4: /**
    5:  * React hook to effortlessly lock body scroll & pause Lenis when a modal/overlay is open.
    6:  * Automatically unlocks body scroll on unmount or when isLocked transitions to false.
    7:  */
    8: export function useBodyScrollLock(isLocked: boolean): void {
    9:   useEffect(() => {
   10:     if (isLocked) {
   11:       lockBodyScroll();
   12:       return () => {
   13:         unlockBodyScroll();
   14:       };
   15:     }
   16:   }, [isLocked]);
   17: }

   34:         bucketName: parsed.bucketName || import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET_NAME || 'xpressnurse-storage',
   35:         endpoint: parsed.endpoint || import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDFLARE_R2_ENDPOINT || '',
   36:         publicDomain: parsed.publicDomain || import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDFLARE_R2_PUBLIC_DOMAIN || ''
   37:       };
   38:       return config;
   39:     }
   40:   } catch (err) {
   41:     console.warn('Failed to load Cloudflare R2 config from localStorage', err);
   42:   }
   43:   return DEFAULT_CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG;
   44: };
   45: 
   46: export const saveCloudflareConfig = (config: Partial<CloudflareR2Config>): CloudflareR2Config => {
   47:   const current = getCloudflareConfig();
   48:   const updated = { ...current, ...config };
   49:   try {
   50:     localStorage.setItem(R2_CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
   51:   } catch (err) {
   52:     console.error('Failed to save Cloudflare R2 config', err);
   53:   }
   54:   return updated;
   55: };

   57: // Cloudflare R2 Storage Bucket Objects (Real objects only — No mock data)
   58: export const SEED_R2_OBJECTS: CloudflareStorageObject[] = [];
   59: 
   60: // Load All Objects
   61: export const getCloudflareObjects = (): CloudflareStorageObject[] => {
   62:   try {
   63:     const saved = localStorage.getItem(R2_OBJECTS_KEY);
   64:     if (saved) {
   65:       const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
   66:       if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
   67:         return parsed;
   68:       }
   69:     }
   70:   } catch (err) {
   71:     console.warn('Failed to load R2 objects from localStorage', err);
   72:   }
   73:   return syncDatabaseRecordsToStorage([], [], []);
   74: };
   75: 
   76: // Save All Objects
   77: export const persistCloudflareObjects = (objects: CloudflareStorageObject[]): void => {
   78:   try {
   79:     localStorage.setItem(R2_OBJECTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(objects));
   80:   } catch (err) {
   81:     console.error('Failed to persist R2 objects', err);
   82:   }
   83: };

   85: // Sync real database records (bookings, prescriptions, nurse certificates) into storage objects
   86: export const syncDatabaseRecordsToStorage = (
   87:   bookings: Booking[] = [],
   88:   nurses: NurseProfile[] = [],
   89:   existingList?: CloudflareStorageObject[]
   90: ): CloudflareStorageObject[] => {
   91:   const config = getCloudflareConfig();
   92:   
   93:   let existing = existingList;
   94:   if (!existing) {
   95:     try {
   96:       const saved = localStorage.getItem(R2_OBJECTS_KEY);
   97:       if (saved) {
   98:         const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
   99:         if (Array.isArray(parsed)) existing = parsed;
  100:       }
  101:     } catch {
  102:       // ignore
  103:     }
  104:   }
  105:   if (!existing) existing = [];
  106: 
  107:   const existingKeyMap = new Map<string, CloudflareStorageObject>();
  108:   existing.forEach((o) => existingKeyMap.set(o.key, o));
  109: 
  110:   const generated: CloudflareStorageObject[] = [];
  111: 
  112:   // Baseline clinical accreditations & operational standards
  113:   const baselineDocs: CloudflareStorageObject[] = [
  114:     {
  115:       id: 'r2-doc-nabh-sop',
  116:       bucketName: config.bucketName,
  117:       key: 'certificates/NABH_Home_Nursing_Clinical_SOP_2026.pdf',
  118:       category: 'certificates',
  119:       fileName: 'NABH_Home_Nursing_Clinical_SOP_2026.pdf',
  120:       contentType: 'application/pdf',
  121:       sizeBytes: 420000,
  122:       uploadedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
  123:       publicUrl: `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/certificates/NABH_Home_Nursing_Clinical_SOP_2026.pdf`,
  124:       metadata: {
  125:         description: 'NABH Accredited Home Nursing Standards & Aseptic Clinical Protocols 2026'
  126:       }
  127:     },
  128:     {
  129:       id: 'r2-doc-tsnc-reg',
  130:       bucketName: config.bucketName,
  131:       key: 'certificates/Telangana_Nursing_Council_Clinical_Registry.pdf',
  132:       category: 'certificates',
  133:       fileName: 'Telangana_Nursing_Council_Clinical_Registry.pdf',
  134:       contentType: 'application/pdf',
  135:       sizeBytes: 310000,
  136:       uploadedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
  137:       publicUrl: `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/certificates/Telangana_Nursing_Council_Clinical_Registry.pdf`,
  138:       metadata: {
  139:         description: 'Telangana State Nursing Council Clinical Institutional Recognition Certificate'
  140:       }
  141:     }
  142:   ];
  143: 
  144:   baselineDocs.forEach((doc) => {
  145:     if (!existingKeyMap.has(doc.key)) {
  146:       generated.push(doc);
  147:     }
  148:   });
  149: 
  150:   // 1. Generate / sync nurse certificates
  151:   const effectiveNurses = nurses || [];
  152:   effectiveNurses.forEach((n) => {
  153:     const cleanName = n.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
  154:     const key = `certificates/RN_Cert_${n.id}_${cleanName}.pdf`;
  155:     if (!existingKeyMap.has(key)) {
  156:       const publicUrl = n.certificateUrl || `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${key}`;
  157:       generated.push({
  158:         id: `r2-cert-${n.id}`,
  159:         bucketName: config.bucketName,
  160:         key,
  161:         category: 'certificates',
  162:         fileName: `Telangana_Council_Cert_${cleanName}.pdf`,
  163:         contentType: 'application/pdf',
  164:         sizeBytes: 245000 + (Math.abs(n.name.length * 3421) % 150000),
  165:         uploadedAt: n.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
  166:         publicUrl,
  167:         metadata: {
  168:           nurseId: n.id,
  169:           patientName: n.name,
  170:           qualification: n.qualification,
  171:           serviceArea: n.serviceArea,
  172:           description: `${n.qualification} - Telangana Nursing Council Registration (${n.certificateVerified ? 'Verified RN' : 'Pending Verification'})`
  173:         }
  174:       });
  175:     }
  176:   });
  177: 
  178:   // 2. Generate / sync booking invoices and prescriptions
  179:   bookings.forEach((b) => {
  180:     const cleanId = b.id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
  181:     const cleanPatient = (b.patientName || 'Patient').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
  182: 
  183:     // Invoice
  184:     const invoiceKey = `invoices/XN-INV-2026-${cleanId}.pdf`;
  185:     if (!existingKeyMap.has(invoiceKey)) {
  186:       const publicUrl = `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${invoiceKey}`;
  187:       generated.push({
  188:         id: `r2-inv-${b.id}`,
  189:         bucketName: config.bucketName,
  190:         key: invoiceKey,
  191:         category: 'invoices',
  192:         fileName: `XN-INV-2026-${cleanId}.pdf`,
  193:         contentType: 'application/pdf',
  194:         sizeBytes: 138000 + (Math.abs(cleanId.length * 2891) % 50000),
  195:         uploadedAt: b.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
  196:         publicUrl,
  197:         metadata: {
  198:           bookingId: b.id,
  199:           patientName: b.patientName,
  200:           serviceTitle: b.serviceTitle,
  201:           totalAmount: b.estimatedFee,
  202:           description: `Clinical Service Doorstep Invoice: ${b.serviceTitle} for ${b.patientName}`
  203:         }
  204:       });
  205:     }
  206: 
  207:     // Prescription (if hasPrescription or fileName or url)
  208:     if (b.hasPrescription || b.prescriptionFileName || b.prescriptionUrl) {
  209:       const rxCleanName = (b.prescriptionFileName || `Rx_Clinical_${cleanPatient}.pdf`).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');
  210:       const rxKey = `prescriptions/Rx_${cleanId}_${rxCleanName}`;
  211:       if (!existingKeyMap.has(rxKey)) {
  212:         const publicUrl = b.prescriptionUrl || `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${rxKey}`;
  213:         generated.push({
  214:           id: `r2-rx-${b.id}`,
  215:           bucketName: config.bucketName,
  216:           key: rxKey,
  217:           category: 'prescriptions',
  218:           fileName: rxCleanName,
  219:           contentType: 'application/pdf',
  220:           sizeBytes: 195000 + (Math.abs(cleanId.length * 4117) % 120000),
  221:           uploadedAt: b.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
  222:           publicUrl,
  223:           metadata: {
  224:             bookingId: b.id,
  225:             patientName: b.patientName,
  226:             patientPhone: b.patientPhone,
  227:             serviceTitle: b.serviceTitle,
  228:             description: `Doctor Mandatory Prescription for ${b.serviceTitle}`
  229:           }
  230:         });
  231:       }
  232:     }
  233:   });
  234: 
  235:   const merged = [...existing, ...generated];
  236:   persistCloudflareObjects(merged);
  237:   return merged;
  238: };
  239: 
  240: // Upload / Save Object to Cloudflare R2
  241: export const uploadToCloudflareStorage = async (
  242:   fileData: {
  243:     fileName: string;
  244:     category: StorageCategory;
  245:     contentType?: string;
  246:     sizeBytes?: number;
  247:     dataUrl?: string;
  248:     metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  249:   }
  250: ): Promise<CloudflareStorageObject> => {
  251:   const config = getCloudflareConfig();
  252:   const cleanCategory = fileData.category;
  253:   const cleanName = fileData.fileName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');
  254:   const key = `${cleanCategory}/${cleanName}`;
  255:   const publicUrl = `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${key}`;
  256: 
  257:   const newObj: CloudflareStorageObject = {
  258:     id: 'r2-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
  259:     bucketName: config.bucketName,
  260:     key,
  261:     category: cleanCategory,
  262:     fileName: cleanName,
  263:     contentType: fileData.contentType || 'application/pdf',
  264:     sizeBytes: fileData.sizeBytes || Math.floor(80000 + Math.random() * 150000),
  265:     uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  266:     publicUrl,
  267:     dataUrl: fileData.dataUrl,
  268:     metadata: fileData.metadata
  269:   };
  270: 
  271:   const existing = getCloudflareObjects();
  272:   const updated = [newObj, ...existing.filter((o) => o.key !== key)];
  273:   persistCloudflareObjects(updated);
  274: 
  275:   return newObj;
  276: };
  277: 
  278: // Specialized Helper: Upload Patient Prescription File Directly to Cloudflare R2 Bucket
  279: export interface PrescriptionUploadPayload {
  280:   file: File;
  281:   patientName: string;
  282:   patientPhone?: string;
  283:   serviceTitle?: string;
  284:   bookingId?: string;
  285: }
  286: 
  287: export const uploadPrescriptionToCloudflareBucket = async (
  288:   payload: PrescriptionUploadPayload
  289: ): Promise<CloudflareStorageObject> => {
  290:   const { file, patientName, patientPhone, serviceTitle, bookingId } = payload;
  291:   const config = getCloudflareConfig();
  292: 
  293:   // Read as Data URL so the uploaded file can be previewed/inspected directly in-browser
  294:   const dataUrl = await new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
  295:     const reader = new FileReader();
  296:     reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
  297:     reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
  298:     reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  299:   });
  300: 
  301:   const timestamp = Date.now();
  302:   const cleanFileName = file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');
  303:   const cleanPrefix = cleanFileName.toLowerCase().startsWith('rx_') ? '' : 'Rx_';
  304:   const cleanBookingId = bookingId ? bookingId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '') : `TMP${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
  305:   const key = `prescriptions/${cleanPrefix}${cleanBookingId}_${cleanFileName}`;
  306:   const publicUrl = `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${key}`;
  307: 
  308:   const newObj: CloudflareStorageObject = {
  309:     id: `r2-rx-${timestamp}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
  310:     bucketName: config.bucketName,
  311:     key,
  312:     category: 'prescriptions',
  313:     fileName: `${cleanPrefix}${cleanBookingId}_${cleanFileName}`,
  314:     contentType: file.type || 'application/pdf',
  315:     sizeBytes: file.size,
  316:     uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  317:     publicUrl,
  318:     dataUrl: dataUrl || undefined,
  319:     metadata: {
  320:       bookingId: bookingId || `BK-${cleanBookingId}`,
  321:       patientName: patientName || 'Prescription Patient',
  322:       patientPhone: patientPhone || '',
  323:       serviceTitle: serviceTitle || 'Home Clinical Nursing Visit',
  324:       description: `Doctor prescription for ${serviceTitle || 'Home Nursing'} stored in Cloudflare R2 Bucket (${config.bucketName})`
  325:     }
  326:   };
  327: 
  328:   const existing = getCloudflareObjects();
  329:   const updated = [newObj, ...existing.filter((o) => o.key !== key)];
  330:   persistCloudflareObjects(updated);
  331: 
  332:   return newObj;
  333: };
  334: 
  335: // Helper to look up a prescription by file name, key, or URL
  336: export const getPrescriptionStorageObject = (
  337:   query?: string
  338: ): CloudflareStorageObject | undefined => {
  339:   if (!query) return undefined;
  340:   const objects = getCloudflareObjects();
  341:   const cleanQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  342:   return objects.find((o) => {
  343:     if (o.key.toLowerCase() === cleanQuery) return true;
  344:     if (o.publicUrl.toLowerCase() === cleanQuery) return true;
  345:     if (o.fileName.toLowerCase() === cleanQuery) return true;
  346:     if (o.category === 'prescriptions') {
  347:       if (cleanQuery.includes(o.fileName.toLowerCase()) || o.fileName.toLowerCase().includes(cleanQuery)) {
  348:         return true;
  349:       }
  350:     }
  351:     return false;
  352:   });
  353: };
  354: 
  355: // Delete Object from Cloudflare R2
  356: export const deleteFromCloudflareStorage = async (keyOrId: string): Promise<void> => {
  357:   const existing = getCloudflareObjects();
  358:   const updated = existing.filter((o) => o.id !== keyOrId && o.key !== keyOrId);
  359:   persistCloudflareObjects(updated);
  360: };

  362: // ============================================================================
  363: // INVOICE BUILDER & GENERATOR
  364: // ============================================================================
  365: 
  366: export const generateInvoiceDetails = (booking: Booking): InvoiceDetails => {
  367:   const config = getCloudflareConfig();
  368:   const cleanBookingId = booking.id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
  369:   const invoiceNumber = `XN-INV-2026-${cleanBookingId}`;
  370:   const baseFee = Number(booking.estimatedFee) || 800;
  371:   const discount = Number(booking.discountRupees) || 0;
  372:   const nightSurcharge = Number(booking.nightSurcharge) || 0;
  373:   const subtotal = Math.max(0, baseFee + nightSurcharge - discount);
  374: 
  375:   const r2StorageKey = `invoices/${invoiceNumber}.pdf`;
  376:   const r2PublicUrl = `${config.publicDomain.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${r2StorageKey}`;
  377: 
  378:   return {
  379:     invoiceNumber,
  380:     invoiceDate: new Date(booking.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
  381:       day: '2-digit',
  382:       month: 'short',
  383:       year: 'numeric'
  384:     }),
  385:     bookingId: booking.id,
  386:     patientName: booking.patientName,
  387:     patientPhone: booking.patientPhone,
  388:     patientAge: booking.patientAge,
  389:     patientGender: booking.patientGender,
  390:     fullAddress: booking.fullAddress,
  391:     area: booking.area,
  392:     serviceTitle: booking.serviceTitle,
  393:     serviceId: booking.serviceId,
  394:     assignedNurseName: booking.assignedNurseName || 'Assigned Fleet RN',
  395:     baseAmount: baseFee,
  396:     nightSurcharge,
  397:     discountRupees: discount,
  398:     totalAmount: subtotal,
  399:     paymentStatus: booking.status === 'Completed' ? 'Paid' : 'Pending',
  400:     paymentMode: 'UPI / Online',
  401:     r2StorageKey,
  402:     r2PublicUrl
  403:   };
  404: };
  405: 
  406: // Upload Invoice to Cloudflare Storage Bucket
  407: export const saveInvoiceToCloudflareBucket = async (booking: Booking): Promise<CloudflareStorageObject> => {
  408:   const inv = generateInvoiceDetails(booking);
  409:   return uploadToCloudflareStorage({
  410:     fileName: `${inv.invoiceNumber}.pdf`,
  411:     category: 'invoices',
  412:     contentType: 'application/pdf',
  413:     sizeBytes: 142000,
  414:     metadata: {
  415:       bookingId: booking.id,
  416:       patientName: booking.patientName,
  417:       nurseName: booking.assignedNurseName,
  418:       amount: inv.totalAmount,
  419:       description: `Service Invoice for ${booking.serviceTitle}`
  420:     }
  421:   });
  422: };

  575: // Open printable invoice window
  576: export const openPrintableInvoiceWindow = (inv: InvoiceDetails): void => {
  577:   const html = generatePrintableInvoiceHtml(inv);
  578:   const win = window.open('', '_blank');
  579:   if (win) {
  580:     win.document.open();
  581:     win.document.write(html);
  582:     win.document.close();
  583:   } else {
  584:     // Fallback: download as HTML file
  585:     const blob = new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' });
  586:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  587:     const a = document.createElement('a');
  588:     a.href = url;
  589:     a.download = `${inv.invoiceNumber}.html`;
  590:     a.click();
  591:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  592:   }
  593: };

    1: let activeLockCount = 0;
    2: let originalOverflow = '';
    3: let originalPaddingRight = '';
    4: 
    5: export function lockBodyScroll(): void {
    6:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    7:   activeLockCount++;
    8:   if (activeLockCount === 1) {
    9:     originalPaddingRight = document.body.style.paddingRight || '';
   10:     originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow || '';
   11:     document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
   12:   }
   13: }
   14: 
   15: export function unlockBodyScroll(): void {
   16:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   17:   activeLockCount = Math.max(0, activeLockCount - 1);
   18:   if (activeLockCount === 0 || !document.querySelector('.modal-overlay')) {
   19:     activeLockCount = 0;
   20:     document.body.style.overflow = '';
   21:     document.body.style.paddingRight = '';
   22:   }
   23: }

  213: export function generateNurseReferralCode(name: string, id: string, phone?: string): string {
  214:   const cleanFirst = (name || '')
  215:     .replace(/^nurse\s+/i, '')
  216:     .trim()
  217:     .split(' ')[0]
  218:     .replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '')
  219:     .toUpperCase() || 'RN';
  220:   const digits = (id || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-3) || (phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-3) || '101';
  221:   return `XN-${cleanFirst}${digits}`;
  222: }
  223: 
  224: export function findNurseByReferralCode(code: string, nurses: NurseProfile[]): NurseProfile | undefined {
  225:   if (!code || !code.trim()) return undefined;
  226:   const clean = code.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
  227:   return nurses.find((n) => {
  228:     const genCode = generateNurseReferralCode(n.name, n.id, n.phone);
  229:     return (
  230:       (n.referralCode && n.referralCode.toUpperCase() === clean) ||
  231:       genCode === clean ||
  232:       n.id.toUpperCase() === clean ||
  233:       n.phone.replace(/\D/g, '') === clean
  234:     );
  235:   });
  236: }

  402:       .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  403: 
  404:     if (error) {
  405:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase bookings fetch error:', error.message);
  406:       return [];
  407:     }
  408:     if (!data) return [];
  409: 
  410:     return data.map((b: any) => ({
  411:       id: b.id,
  412:       createdAt: b.created_at,
  413:       patientName: b.patient_name,
  414:       patientPhone: b.patient_phone,
  415:       patientAge: b.patient_age !== null ? Number(b.patient_age) : undefined,
  416:       patientGender: b.patient_gender || undefined,
  417:       serviceId: b.service_id,
  418:       serviceTitle: b.service_title,
  419:       area: b.area,
  420:       fullAddress: b.full_address,
  421:       bookingType: b.booking_type || (b.preferred_time?.toLowerCase().includes('immediate') || b.preferred_date?.toLowerCase().includes('instant') || b.preferred_date?.toLowerCase().includes('immediate') ? 'Instant' : 'Scheduled'),
  422:       scheduledSlot: b.scheduled_slot || b.preferred_time,
  423:       preferredDate: b.preferred_date,
  424:       preferredTime: b.preferred_time,
  425:       hasPrescription: Boolean(b.has_prescription),
  426:       prescriptionFileName: b.prescription_file_name,
  427:       prescriptionUrl: b.prescription_url,
  428:       status: b.status || 'Assigned',
  429:       nurseAcceptanceStatus: b.nurse_acceptance_status || (
  430:         b.status === 'In-Progress' || b.status === 'Completed'
  431:           ? 'Accepted'
  432:           : (b.status === 'Rejected' && (b.rejected_by === 'Nurse' || b.rejection_reason?.toLowerCase().includes('nurse') || b.notes?.toLowerCase().includes('declined by nurse')))
  433:           ? 'Rejected'
  434:           : (b.assigned_nurse_id ? 'Pending' : undefined)
  435:       ),
  436:       assignedNurseId: b.assigned_nurse_id,
  437:       assignedNurseName: b.assigned_nurse_name,
  438:       referringNurseId: b.referring_nurse_id,
  439:       referringNurseName: b.referring_nurse_name,
  440:       estimatedFee: Number(b.estimated_fee) || 800,
  441:       nightSurcharge: Number(b.night_surcharge) || 0,
  442:       referralBonusRupees: Number(b.referral_bonus_rupees) || 0,
  443:       notes: b.notes,
  444:       rejectionReason: b.rejection_reason || undefined,
  445:       rejectedBy: b.rejected_by || (b.status === 'Rejected' ? (b.rejection_reason?.toLowerCase().includes('nurse') || b.notes?.toLowerCase().includes('declined by nurse') ? 'Nurse' : 'Admin') : undefined),
  446:       rejectedNurseId: b.rejected_nurse_id || undefined,
  447:       rejectedNurseName: b.rejected_nurse_name || undefined,
  448:       rejectedAt: b.rejected_at || undefined
  449:     }));
  450:   } catch (err) {
  451:     console.error('[DB] dbFetchBookings exception:', err);
  452:     return [];
  453:   }
  454: }
  455: 
  456: export async function dbSaveBooking(b: Booking): Promise<boolean> {
  457:   try {
  458:     let isoCreatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  459:     if (b.createdAt && b.createdAt.includes('T')) {
  460:       isoCreatedAt = b.createdAt;
  461:     }
  462: 
  463:     // Clean foreign key values so they are null if unassigned or empty
  464:     const cleanAssignedNurseId = (b.assignedNurseId && b.assignedNurseId.trim() !== '' && b.assignedNurseId !== 'none')
  465:       ? b.assignedNurseId.trim()
  466:       : null;
  467: 
  468:     const cleanReferringNurseId = (b.referringNurseId && b.referringNurseId.trim() !== '' && b.referringNurseId !== 'none')
  469:       ? b.referringNurseId.trim()
  470:       : null;
  471: 
  472:     const cleanServiceId = b.serviceId ? String(b.serviceId).trim() : null;
  473: 
  474:     const payload: any = {
  475:       id: b.id,
  476:       created_at: isoCreatedAt,
  477:       patient_name: b.patientName,
  478:       patient_phone: b.patientPhone,
  479:       patient_age: b.patientAge !== undefined && b.patientAge !== null ? (parseInt(String(b.patientAge)) || null) : null,
  480:       patient_gender: b.patientGender || null,
  481:       service_id: cleanServiceId,
  482:       service_title: b.serviceTitle,
  483:       area: b.area,
  484:       full_address: b.fullAddress,
  485:       booking_type: b.bookingType || 'Instant',
  486:       scheduled_slot: b.scheduledSlot || null,
  487:       preferred_date: b.preferredDate || 'Today',
  488:       preferred_time: b.preferredTime || (b.bookingType === 'Instant' ? 'Immediate (ASAP)' : b.scheduledSlot || 'Slot TBD'),
  489:       has_prescription: Boolean(b.hasPrescription),
  490:       prescription_file_name: b.prescriptionFileName || null,
  491:       prescription_url: b.prescriptionUrl || null,
  492:       status: b.status || 'Assigned',
  493:       assigned_nurse_id: cleanAssignedNurseId,
  494:       assigned_nurse_name: b.assignedNurseName || null,
  495:       referring_nurse_id: cleanReferringNurseId,
  496:       referring_nurse_name: b.referringNurseName || null,
  497:       estimated_fee: Number(b.estimatedFee) || 800.00,
  498:       night_surcharge: Number(b.nightSurcharge) || 0.00,
  499:       referral_bonus_rupees: Number(b.referralBonusRupees) || 0.00,
  500:       notes: b.notes || null,
  501:       rejection_reason: b.rejectionReason || null
  502:     };
  503: 
  504:     const { error } = await supabase.from('bookings').upsert(payload);
  505:     if (error) {
  506:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase bookings save warning:', error.message);
  507:       if (error.message && error.message.includes('column')) {
  508:         const fallbackPayload = { ...payload };
  509:         if (fallbackPayload.rejection_reason) {
  510:           fallbackPayload.notes = (fallbackPayload.notes ? fallbackPayload.notes + ' • ' : '') + `Rejection: ${fallbackPayload.rejection_reason}`;
  511:           delete fallbackPayload.rejection_reason;
  512:         }
  513:         delete fallbackPayload.booking_type;
  514:         delete fallbackPayload.scheduled_slot;
  515:         const retry = await supabase.from('bookings').upsert(fallbackPayload);
  516:         if (!retry.error) return true;
  517:         console.error('[DB] Supabase bookings save retry error:', retry.error.message);
  518:       }
  519:       return false;
  520:     }
  521: 
  522:     return true;
  523:   } catch (err) {
  524:     console.error('[DB] dbSaveBooking exception:', err);
  525:     return false;
  526:   }
  527: }
  528: 
  529: export async function dbInsertBooking(b: Booking): Promise<boolean> {
  530:   return dbSaveBooking(b);
  531: }

  533: export async function dbUpdateBooking(id: string, updates: Partial<Booking>): Promise<boolean> {
  534:   const payload: any = {};
  535:   if (updates.patientName !== undefined) payload.patient_name = updates.patientName;
  536:   if (updates.patientPhone !== undefined) payload.patient_phone = updates.patientPhone;
  537:   if (updates.patientAge !== undefined) payload.patient_age = parseInt(String(updates.patientAge)) || null;
  538:   if (updates.patientGender !== undefined) payload.patient_gender = updates.patientGender || null;
  539:   if (updates.serviceTitle !== undefined) payload.service_title = updates.serviceTitle;
  540:   if (updates.serviceId !== undefined) {
  541:     payload.service_id = updates.serviceId ? String(updates.serviceId).trim() : null;
  542:   }
  543:   if (updates.area !== undefined) payload.area = updates.area;
  544:   if (updates.fullAddress !== undefined) payload.full_address = updates.fullAddress;
  545:   if (updates.bookingType !== undefined) payload.booking_type = updates.bookingType;
  546:   if (updates.scheduledSlot !== undefined) payload.scheduled_slot = updates.scheduledSlot;
  547:   if (updates.preferredDate !== undefined) payload.preferred_date = updates.preferredDate || null;
  548:   if (updates.preferredTime !== undefined) payload.preferred_time = updates.preferredTime || null;
  549:   if (updates.status !== undefined) payload.status = updates.status;
  550:   if (updates.rejectionReason !== undefined) payload.rejection_reason = updates.rejectionReason || null;
  551:   if (updates.hasPrescription !== undefined) payload.has_prescription = Boolean(updates.hasPrescription);
  552:   if (updates.prescriptionFileName !== undefined) payload.prescription_file_name = updates.prescriptionFileName || null;
  553:   if (updates.prescriptionUrl !== undefined) payload.prescription_url = updates.prescriptionUrl || null;
  554:   if (updates.assignedNurseId !== undefined) {
  555:     payload.assigned_nurse_id = (updates.assignedNurseId && updates.assignedNurseId.trim() !== '' && updates.assignedNurseId !== 'none') ? updates.assignedNurseId.trim() : null;
  556:   }
  557:   if (updates.assignedNurseName !== undefined) payload.assigned_nurse_name = updates.assignedNurseName || null;
  558:   if (updates.referringNurseId !== undefined) {
  559:     payload.referring_nurse_id = (updates.referringNurseId && updates.referringNurseId.trim() !== '' && updates.referringNurseId !== 'none') ? updates.referringNurseId.trim() : null;
  560:   }
  561:   if (updates.referringNurseName !== undefined) payload.referring_nurse_name = updates.referringNurseName || null;
  562:   if (updates.estimatedFee !== undefined) payload.estimated_fee = Number(updates.estimatedFee);
  563:   if (updates.nightSurcharge !== undefined) payload.night_surcharge = Number(updates.nightSurcharge);
  564:   if (updates.referralBonusRupees !== undefined) payload.referral_bonus_rupees = Number(updates.referralBonusRupees);
  565:   if (updates.notes !== undefined) payload.notes = updates.notes || null;
  566: 
  567:   try {
  568:     const { error } = await supabase.from('bookings').update(payload).eq('id', id);
  569:     if (error) {
  570:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase bookings update warning:', error.message);
  571:       if (error.message && error.message.includes('column')) {
  572:         const fallbackPayload = { ...payload };
  573:         if (fallbackPayload.rejection_reason) {
  574:           fallbackPayload.notes = (fallbackPayload.notes ? fallbackPayload.notes + ' • ' : '') + `Rejection: ${fallbackPayload.rejection_reason}`;
  575:           delete fallbackPayload.rejection_reason;
  576:         }
  577:         delete fallbackPayload.booking_type;
  578:         delete fallbackPayload.scheduled_slot;
  579:         const retry = await supabase.from('bookings').update(fallbackPayload).eq('id', id);
  580:         return !retry.error;
  581:       }
  582:       return false;
  583:     }
  584:     return true;
  585:   } catch {
  586:     return false;
  587:   }
  588: }

  591:   try {
  592:     const { error } = await supabase.from('bookings').delete().eq('id', id);
  593:     return !error;
  594:   } catch {
  595:     return false;
  596:   }

  603: export async function dbFetchLeads(): Promise<NurseLead[] | null> {
  604:   try {
  605:     const { data, error } = await supabase
  606:       .from('leads')
  607:       .select('*')
  608:       .order('submitted_at', { ascending: false });
  609: 
  610:     if (error) {
  611:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase leads fetch error:', error.message);
  612:       return [];
  613:     }
  614:     if (!data) return [];

  616:     return data.map((l: any) => ({
  617:       id: l.id,

  620:       patientPhone: l.patient_phone || l.referred_nurse_phone,
  621:       serviceId: l.service_id,
  622:       area: l.area,
  623:       submittedAt: l.submitted_at,
  624:       status: l.status || 'Converted',
  625:       assignedNurseId: l.assigned_nurse_id,
  626:       leadValueRupees: Number(l.lead_value_rupees) || 1000.00,
  627:       pointsAwarded: Math.round(Number(l.points_awarded)) || 50,
  628:       referralCommissionRupees: Number(l.referral_commission_rupees) || 100.00,
  629:       referredNurseName: l.referred_nurse_name || l.patient_name || undefined,
  630:       referredNursePhone: l.referred_nurse_phone || l.patient_phone || undefined,
  631:       qualification: l.qualification || undefined,
  632:       experienceYears: Number(l.experience_years) || 3,
  633:       rejectionReason: l.rejection_reason || undefined
  634:     }));
  635:   } catch (err) {
  636:     console.error('[DB] dbFetchLeads exception:', err);
  637:     return [];
  638:   }
  639: }

  641: export async function dbSaveLead(lead: NurseLead): Promise<boolean> {
  642:   try {
  643:     let isoSubmittedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  644:     if (lead.submittedAt && lead.submittedAt.includes('T')) {
  645:       isoSubmittedAt = lead.submittedAt;
  646:     }
  647: 
  648:     const cleanNurseId = (lead.nurseId && lead.nurseId.trim() !== '' && lead.nurseId !== 'none') ? lead.nurseId.trim() : null;
  649:     const cleanAssignedNurseId = (lead.assignedNurseId && lead.assignedNurseId.trim() !== '' && lead.assignedNurseId !== 'none') ? lead.assignedNurseId.trim() : null;
  650: 
  651:     const payload: any = {
  652:       id: lead.id,
  653:       nurse_id: cleanNurseId,
  654:       patient_name: lead.patientName || lead.referredNurseName || null,
  655:       patient_phone: lead.patientPhone || lead.referredNursePhone || null,
  656:       service_id: lead.serviceId || null,
  657:       area: lead.area,
  658:       submitted_at: isoSubmittedAt,
  659:       status: lead.status || 'Converted',
  660:       assigned_nurse_id: cleanAssignedNurseId,
  661:       lead_value_rupees: Number(lead.leadValueRupees) || 1000.00,
  662:       points_awarded: Math.round(Number(lead.pointsAwarded)) || 50,
  663:       referral_commission_rupees: Number(lead.referralCommissionRupees) || 100.00,
  664:       referred_nurse_name: lead.referredNurseName || lead.patientName || null,
  665:       referred_nurse_phone: lead.referredNursePhone || lead.patientPhone || null,
  666:       qualification: lead.qualification || null,
  667:       experience_years: Math.round(Number(lead.experienceYears)) || 3,
  668:       rejection_reason: lead.rejectionReason || null
  669:     };
  670: 
  671:     const { error } = await supabase.from('leads').upsert(payload);
  672:     if (error) {
  673:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase leads save warning:', error.message);
  674:       if (error.message && error.message.includes('column')) {
  675:         const fallback = {
  676:           id: payload.id,
  677:           nurse_id: payload.nurse_id,
  678:           patient_name: payload.patient_name,
  679:           patient_phone: payload.patient_phone,
  680:           service_id: payload.service_id,
  681:           area: payload.area,
  682:           submitted_at: payload.submitted_at,
  683:           status: payload.status,
  684:           assigned_nurse_id: payload.assigned_nurse_id,
  685:           lead_value_rupees: payload.lead_value_rupees,
  686:           points_awarded: payload.points_awarded,
  687:           referral_commission_rupees: payload.referral_commission_rupees
  688:         };
  689:         const retry = await supabase.from('leads').upsert(fallback);
  690:         if (!retry.error) return true;
  691:         console.error('[DB] Supabase leads save retry error:', retry.error.message);
  692:       }
  693:       return false;
  694:     }
  695:     return true;
  696:   } catch (err) {
  697:     console.error('[DB] dbSaveLead exception:', err);
  698:     return false;
  699:   }
  700: }

  702: export async function dbInsertLead(lead: NurseLead): Promise<boolean> {
  703:   return dbSaveLead(lead);

  706: export async function dbUpdateLeadById(id: string, updates: Partial<NurseLead>): Promise<boolean> {
  707:   const payload: any = {};
  708:   if (updates.patientName !== undefined) payload.patient_name = updates.patientName;
  709:   if (updates.patientPhone !== undefined) payload.patient_phone = updates.patientPhone;
  710:   if (updates.serviceId !== undefined) payload.service_id = updates.serviceId;
  711:   if (updates.area !== undefined) payload.area = updates.area;
  712:   if (updates.status !== undefined) payload.status = updates.status;
  713:   if (updates.nurseId !== undefined) {
  714:     payload.nurse_id = (updates.nurseId && updates.nurseId.trim() !== '' && updates.nurseId !== 'none') ? updates.nurseId.trim() : null;
  715:   }
  716:   if (updates.assignedNurseId !== undefined) {
  717:     payload.assigned_nurse_id = (updates.assignedNurseId && updates.assignedNurseId.trim() !== '' && updates.assignedNurseId !== 'none') ? updates.assignedNurseId.trim() : null;
  718:   }
  719:   if (updates.pointsAwarded !== undefined) payload.points_awarded = Math.round(Number(updates.pointsAwarded));
  720:   if (updates.leadValueRupees !== undefined) payload.lead_value_rupees = Number(updates.leadValueRupees);
  721:   if (updates.referralCommissionRupees !== undefined) payload.referral_commission_rupees = Number(updates.referralCommissionRupees);
  722:   if (updates.referredNurseName !== undefined) payload.referred_nurse_name = updates.referredNurseName;
  723:   if (updates.referredNursePhone !== undefined) payload.referred_nurse_phone = updates.referredNursePhone;
  724:   if (updates.qualification !== undefined) payload.qualification = updates.qualification;
  725:   if (updates.experienceYears !== undefined) payload.experience_years = Math.round(Number(updates.experienceYears));
  726:   if (updates.rejectionReason !== undefined) payload.rejection_reason = updates.rejectionReason;
  727: 
  728:   try {
  729:     const { error } = await supabase.from('leads').update(payload).eq('id', id);
  730:     if (error) {
  731:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase leads update warning:', error.message);
  732:       if (error.message && error.message.includes('column')) {
  733:         const fallback: any = {};
  734:         const safeLeadKeys = ['patient_name', 'patient_phone', 'service_id', 'area', 'status', 'nurse_id', 'assigned_nurse_id', 'points_awarded', 'lead_value_rupees', 'referral_commission_rupees'];
  735:         safeLeadKeys.forEach((k) => {
  736:           if (payload[k] !== undefined) fallback[k] = payload[k];
  737:         });
  738:         const retry = await supabase.from('leads').update(fallback).eq('id', id);
  739:         return !retry.error;
  740:       }
  741:       return false;
  742:     }
  743:     return true;
  744:   } catch {
  745:     return false;
  746:   }
  747: }

  752:     return !error;

  754:     return false;
  755:   }

  859: export async function dbFetchCoupons(): Promise<Coupon[] | null> {
  860:   try {
  861:     const { data, error } = await supabase
  862:       .from('coupons')
  863:       .select('*')
  864:       .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  865: 
  866:     if (error) {
  867:       console.warn('[DB] Supabase coupons fetch error:', error.message);
  868:       return [];
  869:     }
  870:     if (!data) return [];
  871: 
  872:     return data.map((c: any) => ({
  873:       id: c.id,
  874:       code: c.code,
  875:       discountType: c.discount_type as 'flat' | 'percent',
  876:       discountValue: Number(c.discount_value),
  877:       maxDiscount: c.max_discount !== null && c.max_discount !== undefined ? Number(c.max_discount) : undefined,
  878:       minOrderAmount: c.min_order_amount !== null && c.min_order_amount !== undefined ? Number(c.min_order_amount) : 0,
  879:       description: c.description || '',
  880:       status: (c.status || 'Active') as 'Active' | 'Inactive' | 'Expired',
  881:       usageLimit: c.usage_limit !== null && c.usage_limit !== undefined ? Number(c.usage_limit) : undefined,
  882:       timesUsed: Number(c.times_used) || 0,
  883:       validUntil: c.valid_until || undefined,
  884:       createdAt: c.created_at,
  885:       updatedAt: c.updated_at
  886:     }));
  887:   } catch (err) {
  888:     console.error('[DB] dbFetchCoupons exception:', err);
  889:     return [];
  890:   }
  891: }
